conditions: Only one adversary at a time: clear or convert any active Kuva Lich, Sister, or Coda first, and claim any unclaimed adversary weapon sitting in your Foundry — it silently blocks new Candidates too.
Ergo Glast never sells the Plinx — his Corrupted Holokey shop only carries Grigori, Livia, Exec, Agendus and Ferrox. Every ranged Tenet weapon comes from a Sister.

groups.activity: clear the Nightmare Granum Void; inspect Candidates

rows.label: Tenet Plinx Candidate
rows.note: Mercy only when the weapon preview says Plinx
rows.alt: buy a converted Tenet Plinx Sister

rows.label: progenitor element
rows.note: Heat is most-recommended, doubling down on Plinx's innate Heat; Magnetic and Radiation are defensible; Toxin is a trap, it auto-combines with the innate Heat into Gas
rows.alt: Elemental Vice can change it later at rank 40

conditions: You only need Rank 1 (25 kills solo) for a Candidate to spawn; the kill requirement rises +25 per squad member.

A Treasurer spawns 2-5 minutes into any non-endless Corpus Ship mission and drops a Crown tiered by level; level 31+ or Steel Path drops the Zenith, the only tier that spawns a Candidate. Zenith nodes: Neptune Psamathe, Neptune Larissa, Pluto Acheron, Pluto Cypress, Pluto Hydra.
Open the Void far from extraction and walk out slowly afterward — within roughly 150-200m of extraction, or sprinting out, suppresses the Candidate spawn entirely.
If the preview isn't Plinx, leave her and complete and extract from the mission. Aborting does not remove that weapon from the pool; only a completed rejection does.

The Sister-carried pool is 11 weapons (Arca Plasmor, Cycron, Detron, Diplos, Envoy, Flux Rifle, Glaxion, Plinx, Quanta, Spirex, Tetra), so correctly rejecting guarantees Plinx inside 11 completed missions.
Only the last player to damage the Candidate may Mercy her.
bonuses: Xoris, even 0-forma, one-shots Errant Specters regardless of level and frees Solaris captives for +20s each on detonation.

disclosures.title: finish the mission on every reject
disclosures.body: The pool is a shuffle, not a slot machine: a rejected weapon stays out until all eleven have been refused, so a Plinx is guaranteed within eleven Candidates. Abort the mission instead of extracting and the rejection doesn't count, and you've burned a crown for nothing.

groups.activity: Mercy Hounds, reveal Requiems, test the sequence
groups.mode: long missions first, then fast ones
conditions: Requiem mods all come from the single Requiem Eterna relic (all 8 mods at equal chance), from Kuva Siphon (50%) or Kuva Flood (100%); the retired Requiem I-IV relics are sold by Palladino for 10 Riven Slivers each, 10 weekly per relic.
Kill her Hound before you drop her health bar — if it's alive when the bar empties, she orders it to self-destruct and that mission's Hound murmurs are lost.
Sisters have damage attenuation: low-damage, high-fire-rate weapons beat one big hit. Banshee's Sonar bypasses attenuation entirely, and Sevagoth's Gloom drastically slows her.
bonuses: Run the Neptune Proxima confrontation in a full squad: one Corrupted Holokey per member, up to 4.

disclosures.title: Oull-first Parazon
disclosures.body: Slot Oull in position 1: it guarantees the first health bar breaks every encounter, forcing an extra Hound spawn and an extra murmur. Leave it there as long as it makes sense.

rows.label: Tenet Plinx
rows.note: built; Foundry delivery, her Hound fully built too

conditions: Choose Vanquish, never Convert — Convert gives an ally and a tradeable Sister token but no weapon, and the recipient still has to re-fight her.
Kill her Hounds and both Warframe Specters; she is invulnerable until her backup is dead.
bonuses: Vanquish also refunds taxed credits, any ephemera, a 25% shot at a Requiem Ultimatum, and one Corrupted Holokey per squad member.

disclosures.title: use it safely
disclosures.body: Plinx's alt-fire self-staggers. Primed Sure Footed or an ability cast during the 0.8s embed delay skips the knockdown.

conditions: Fusion takes the higher of the two bonuses × 1.1, capped at 60%.
Fuse into the copy you've invested in — the donor's Catalyst, Forma, Exilus adapter and Elemental Vice are all destroyed.
Elemental Vice needs rank 40 (5 Forma): 50,000 Hex standing at Rank 5, 20 platinum from the Market, or a Temporal Archimedea/Nightwave drop.

disclosures.title: the 60% chase is optional
disclosures.body: Consensus is the Sister grind itself 'isn't that bad, easier than lich, worse than coda.' The regretted route is building a whole plan around one progenitor element instead of using Elemental Vice; get a usable copy first, then only fuse when a donor beats what you're keeping.
